audit.whatIsWrong: Two recurring factual errors. (1) Spirit Cleave (W) is described as lifesteal/sustain in whys[5], mid, late and wants.foe[2] — Riot's text says it grants a shield, scaled by champions hit, with cooldown and cast time scaling with attack speed. (2) Fate Sealed (R) is called a knockup in whys[4], whys[6], spikes[2] and mid — Riot's text says he blinks behind the last champion in a line and pulls all enemies hit toward him. The knockup in this kit is the third Mortal Steel stack, not the ultimate.
audit.why: Both errors change what the reader should do: anti-heal does nothing against a shield, and you dodge a pull differently from a knockup. Kit flags confirm W=shield with no heal flag, and R carries dash with no knockup flag.
audit.corrected: Spirit Cleave is a 14s shield; Fate Sealed pulls you toward him on 120s at rank 1; the knockup is the second Gathering Storm stack on Mortal Steel.
sources: enemyKit W text and shield flag

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Quinn Level 6 and 2+ items outright.
audit.why: 51.42% over 492 games; the packet chart is Quinn rows 0-2, Skill rows 3-5, Yone row 6. whys[4] literally says 'neither side gets a clean window' under a row marked Quinn 8/10, and whys[6] says he out-scales hard under a row marked Quinn.
audit.corrected: Row 4 to Skill, row 6 to Yone, both layers.

audit.why: Spike ladder holds: Quinn owns Lvl 1-3 before Mortal Steel stacks and Spirit Cleave, level 6 flattens it, and Yone takes over at 2+ items. Soul Unbound dropping from 22s to 10s across ranks is the reason the free-trade window closes at 4-5.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown block gave no numbers for any of his abilities.
audit.why: Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 and 10s maxed, Spirit Cleave is 14s, Fate Sealed is 120s at rank 1 — those three numbers are the entire trading rhythm.
sources: enemyKit E, W and R cooldowns

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d are template filler that never mention the Q3 knockup or the Soul Unbound snap-back their headings promise.
audit.corrected: Q-stack body for 'Get hit by his Q3'; snap-back body for 'Fight during his E burst'.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — He snaps back when it ends. Blind there. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Soul Unbound (E): 22s at rank 1, 10s maxed — he snaps back and repeats his damage, so blind the return, not the exit. - Spirit Cleave (W): 14s shield, scaled by attack speed. - Fate Sealed (R): 120s at rank 1.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 even out. Yone gets W spirit-cleave for lane sustain and his Q stacks faster, so your free trades dry up — now it's a timing game around his third Q and his E spirit-rewind. He E's out of anything he loses, snapping back to his marked position with a damage burst, so don't blow your whole combo if his E is up. At 6 his R knockup makes a deep all-in a death sentence; use your own R to roam or shove for plates instead of forcing a coinflip duel.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 even out. Yone gets Spirit Cleave for a 14-second shield and his Q stacks faster, so your free trades dry up — now it's a timing game around his third Mortal Steel and Soul Unbound. He E's out of anything he loses, snapping back to his body and repeating a portion of his damage, so don't blow your whole combo while it is up. At 6 Fate Sealed pulls you in and makes a deep all-in a death sentence; roam or shove for plates instead.

edits.before: This flips to Yone. Two items in he's a mobile carry — his Q-dash gap-close ignores your kite, spirit-cleave lifesteal sustains through your poke, and most of his damage is on abilities that your Q blind does nothing to stop. You're squishy with no front-to-back threat and he just dashes onto you and R-knockups you out of position. You had to win this on the map by now: snowball the early lead with R roams and end before his item spikes land, or he reclaims the lane and the game.
edits.after: This flips to Yone. Two items in he's a mobile carry — his Q-dash gap-close ignores your kite, Spirit Cleave shields off your poke every 14 seconds, and most of his damage is on abilities that your Q blind does nothing to stop. You're squishy with no front-to-back threat and he dashes onto you and Fate Sealed pulls you out of position. You had to win this on the map by now: snowball the early lead with R roams and end before his item spikes land, or he reclaims the game.

edits.before: Reach 2+ items where spirit-cleave lifesteal and his Q mobility let him run you down
edits.after: Reach 2+ items where the Spirit Cleave shield and Q mobility let him run you down

notes: The itemization panel recommends early anti-heal because 'his healing fights your pattern'. Yone has no healing in his kit — Spirit Cleave shields, it does not heal — so that clause is boilerplate carried in from another matchup and Grievous Wounds is a wasted slot here. I did not edit report[8].t because rewriting the item core is out of scope for a text fix, but it should be corrected.
